text:
PagerDuty: INC-3287 triggered: high error rate + increased latency on infer-pool-usw-2. paging oncall.
Maya Chen: seeing kubelet restarts on 3 nodes in infer-pool-usw-2, NotReady flapping. CPU fine, but docker/containerd churn and kernel OOM logs in dmesg on one node.
infra-bot: alert summary: pod_eviction_count spike, node_not_ready events x3, 95th latency -> 1.6s (baseline 0.3s), error rate 502->1.8% in last 5m.
Alex R.: tagging @Maya — impact to customers? any 5xx spikes on hosted API?
Maya Chen: hosted api traces show a subset of requests routed to that pool got 503/504 retries. Topline: small fraction of requests failed but tail latency for real-time customers spiked, causing retries and some downstream timeouts. Two customers reported increased errors.
Keoni: can we cordon + drain the flapping nodes and let autoscaler replace? recommend `kubectl cordon node-abc && kubectl drain node-abc --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then confirm model pods land on healthy nodes.
Sophie L.: I'm on it — draining node-abc and node-def now. will watch pod startup logs.
Maya Chen: noticed GPU driver tracebacks in syslog on node-abc: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79`. Could be driver/kernel mismatch causing container crashes.
Alex R.: deploy-bot: pause model-serving rollout? I think a recent consolidation rollout targeted wp-infer pool ~ 15m ago.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for model-serving/v2.3.1 by Alex R. — auto-rollback disabled.
Keoni: good call. we should avoid new pods landing with the same image until root cause known. also suggest temporarily routing traffic away from infer-pool-usw-2 -> infer-pool-usw-1 and infer-pool-eu-west. can ops-routing help?
Maya Chen: switching routing config to reduce weight to infer-pool-usw-2 by 80% now. updating route policy.
infra-bot: route update applied: infer-pool-usw-2 weight 20%.
Sophie L.: drained two nodes successfully; pods rescheduled to other nodes but a few failed with `OOMKilled` in runtime container early during init — logs show large prewarm cache allocation.
Alex R.: threshold for prewarm should be lowered if nodes are memory-constrained. can we change instance startup args to disable large cache for now?
Keoni: yes — patching the deployment config to set `PREWARM_CACHE_BYTES=0` in the model server env for canary replicas. applying to a single replica first.
Maya Chen: applied canary env change to 1 replica. new pod started healthy on healthy node. latency for canary normal.
Sophie L.: observed 503s stop for requests routed away; overall error rate falling to 0.4% now.
PagerDuty: oncall acknowledged by Maya Chen (15:02 UTC).
Maya Chen: customer-impact assessment: two customers with spikes — one experienced transient 10% error rate for ~12 minutes, second had increased latency causing timeouts in their retries. No data exfiltration.
Alex R.: next steps: 1) keep routing reduced, 2) replace flapping nodes, 3) hold rollouts for model-serving, 4) follow up with infra team on GPU driver Xid 79. assign postmortem.
Sophie L.: replacing 3 kube nodes in infer-pool-usw-2 via cloud provider (create new instances, rotate). starting rotation now. ETA ~20m.
Maya Chen: creating incident ticket INC-3287-ops for postmortem + RCA, will include metrics, logs, and affected customers.
Keoni: add remediation item: add watchdog to detect repeated Xid 79 in dmesg and trigger automated node quarantine before pods get evicted en masse.
Alex R.: handing off to night oncall @oncall-night for monitoring and follow-up. if anything flares up escalate to infra-sre.
oncall-night: acknowledged — will monitor error rate and node status for next 6h.
infra-bot: summary at 15:21 UTC: routing adjusted, 3 nodes draining/replaced, rollout paused, canary env change applied, customer impact limited. monitoring.
Maya Chen: I'll prep a short customer-facing blurb for CS: impacted requests were routed through infer-pool-usw-2 during brief node instability; we throttled traffic and fixed node rotation; customers may have seen transient errors.
Alex R.: thanks team. will collate logs for the postmortem. closing incident once node rotation completes and error rate stable for 60m.
Sophie L.: node rotation complete at 15:40 UTC; monitoring shows stable node heartbeats and no new Xid 79 occurrences.
Maya Chen: marking status -> monitoring. follow-up ticket created: INFRA-5721. expected postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
